 Motilal Oswal's research report on Hindustan Zinc 
 Hindustan Zinc’s (HZL) Board approved an INR800b expansion plan to nearly double its annual metal production capacity from 1.1mtpa to 2mtpa over the next 3-5 years. Under the program, the company will scale its annual zinc capacity from 0.93mtpa to 1.61mtpa, which includes a new 500ktpa zinc smelter alongside an upgraded 265ktpa integrated zinc smelter at Debari, Rajasthan, scheduled for commissioning by 2QFY29. Simultaneously, the lead production capacity will double from 0.2mtpa to 0.4mtpa via a new 200ktpa smelter and the annual silver refining capacity to increase from 800tpa to 1,500tpa through a new 700tpa refinery. Management guided that to feed these expanded smelting operations, the company will increase its ore production capacity from 19.3mtpa to 35mtpa at across mines.
 Outlook 
 At CMP, HZ trades at 6.2x FY28E EV/EBITDA, and we believe the current valuation has priced in all the positive factors. We reiterate our Neutral rating with a TP of INR600 (premised on 7x EV/EBITDA on FY28E).
